$schema_note: Spatial evidence ledger for the EARTH observatory pages. One row per load-bearing observation or claim. A public page may cite a claim only by claim_id. Verdicts on pages must trace to rows here. Epistemic labels: OBS = directly observed/measured, DER = derived by stated calculation, INT = interpretation of observations, SPEC = speculative working hypothesis, EXT = external cross-check awaiting a georeferenced primary source.
purpose: Answer four questions for every body, number and verdict: Where exactly? Measured by what? At what resolution? What observation can kill it? Fields the source does not publish are null with an explicit gap flag — null is honest, inferred coordinates are not.

claims.claim: Moho depth 32.8 ± 2.5 km at the KMY broadband station
claims.label: OBS
claims.method: P-to-S receiver function H-kappa stacking (Zhu & Kanamori 2000)
claims.georeference_status: RESOLVED 2026-10-26 — station = transect control point 'Kota Kinabalu', chainage 429.9 km (coordinates published in evidence_chain.json OBS-SABAH-RF-001)
claims.collocation: A/D discrimination predictions defined at chainage 520.0 km → 90.1 km along-chain / 82.5 km straight-line from station — outside RF footprint (~20–30 km). Verdict: INDETERMINATE at prediction point; observation decides only the ~430 km (KK) domain
claims.resolution_footprint: Fresnel-zone scale (~20–30 km) at 33 km depth, 0.2–0.5 Hz
claims.source: Sidek et al. 2016 (doi:10.7186/bgsm62201607); Madon et al. 2025
models_contradicted: none at 520 km — original Model-D kill WITHDRAWN as collocation error (evidence_chain.json audit_amendment_2026_10_26)
models_supported: ~30–35 km Moho in the Kota Kinabalu (430 km) domain
claims.kill_power: DECISIVE only for predictions within its footprint. Decisive observation to unblock D3: broadband station ≤ ~25 km from the 520 km prediction point (per the run's own on_indeterminate consequence).

claims.claim: Moho near 60 km beneath the Crocker Range
claims.label: OBS/INT (receiver-function estimate)
claims.georeference_status: REGIONAL — 'beneath Crocker Range'; chainage ≈ 485 km on the Sabah transect family, footprint broad
claims.interface_definition: crust–mantle velocity step (RF) — different estimator than CL-MOHO-KMY-328
claims.source: Gilligan et al. 2026 (doi:10.1029/2025JB031499) as cited on the pages; observatory Model-R panel cites receiver functions near 60 km beneath Crocker
models_supported: crustal thickening under Crocker (Models A/C/D crust panels)
claims.kill_power: SUPPORTS a thickened root at Crocker; cannot be compared pointwise with CL-MOHO-KMY-328 — different station, estimator, and resolution. Not a contradiction between them; an un-normalised comparison.

claims.label: OBS/INT
claims.georeference_status: REGIONAL — 'central Sabah' province label, no point
claims.source: Gilligan et al. 2026, as cited on earth/kinabalu-cross-section.html
claims.kill_power: NON-DECISIVE against any single model — spatially distinct from the Crocker and KMY points; all three can coexist in a heterogeneous Moho field.

claims.label: DER
claims.source: Madon et al. 2025 (as cited on the observatory Model-R panel)
models_contradicted: Model R flat 30 km Moho (disfavoured at the thick end)
claims.kill_power: CONSTRAINS, NEVER CONFIRMS — potential-field solutions are non-unique; a fit is PERMITTED, not proven.

claims.claim: There is no direct Moho control beneath the Mt Kinabalu summit
claims.label: OBS (of absence)
claims.uncertainty: asymmetric — future station may fill it
claims.kill_power: BLOCKS any kill verdict whose spatial prediction is summit-specific; the section must keep the gap open (kinabalu-cross-section.html already leaves 230–540 km Moho undrawn).

claims.claim: Regional surface-wave tomography: Sabah crustal thickness ~25–55 km; average LAB ~100 km; localized lithospheric thinning in southeastern Sabah — not wholesale removal
claims.label: EXT
claims.georeference_status: AWAITING-CITATION — entered from the 2026-10-26 enterprise cross-check; a named, georeferenced primary reference must be attached before any page states it as fact
models_supported: D2 — localized SE Sabah lithosphere instability/thinning
claims.kill_power: Kills only the Sabah-WIDE removal variant, not every localized drip. Model-family verdicts must be split D1/D2/D3 accordingly.

claims.claim: A west-dipping discontinuity exists at 45–55 km depth offshore NW Sabah; it is interpreted as a detached slab remnant (and associated with Celebes Sea subduction)
claims.label: OBS (discontinuity) + INT (slab identity)
claims.georeference_status: offshore NW Sabah, on the transect family; footprint broad
claims.uncertainty: interpretation of body identity is contested
claims.source: Cornwell et al. 2025, JGR Solid Earth 130(11) e2025JB031466
claims.transect_ref: T-KIN-XS-833 Model D body, T-SAB-OBS-833 Model C annotation
claims.kill_power: The discontinuity supports a slab-like body; it does NOT prove drip dynamics, slab breakoff timing, or crustal architecture.

claims.claim: Deep Regional Unconformity surface age ~14.2 Ma (NN5); deliberately kept separate from the hypothesized slab-breakoff episode (~13–12 Ma, Morley 2024); DRU must not be auto-read as collision onset
claims.label: INT (correlation)
claims.source: GEOX Sabah unconformity correlation (geox://earth-system/sabah-correlation); Morley 2024 for breakoff window
claims.kill_power: NON-DECISIVE for dynamics; separates age-evidence from event-interpretation.

claims.claim: Mt Kinabalu granite is a dated Late Miocene pluton (7.85–7.22 Ma emplacement pulses with rapid exhumation)
claims.label: OBS (published geochronology)
claims.source: Cottam et al. 2010 (JGS 167:49–60); Cottam et al. 2013 (JGS 170:805–816)
claims.kill_power: GENETIC FIREWALL: this dated onshore pluton does NOT date or validate any hypothesized offshore trough-axis intrusion; similar timing would still not prove a common source or pathway.

claims.claim: Sparse transtensional sills/dykes may exploit an inherited thinned crustal axis beneath the Sabah Trough
claims.label: SPEC (untested working hypothesis; ridge-push mechanism withdrawn 2026-10)
claims.georeference_status: along the Sabah Trough axis (schematic polyline 5.75N 113.95E → 7.70N 115.75E)
claims.source: Fazil 2026 working note, kinabalu-cross-section.html Model A; potential-field thinning as motivating OBS
claims.physical_admissibility: PERMITTED — no published observation contradicts it
claims.empirical_maturity: OPEN — no dated basalt, no corrected low-latitude magnetic lineation, no seismic-imaged sill, no localized paleo-thermal spike yet public
claims.kill_power: Kill test: adequately-resolved seismic + potential-field coverage excluding required body geometries ⇒ reject that configuration; insufficient coverage ⇒ INCONCLUSIVE. A potential-field fit ⇒ PERMITTED, never proven.

claims.claim: A Miocene mobile-shale mud canopy (North Sabah–Pagasa Wedge) exists, imaged by 3D seismic pipes, saucers and mini-basins
claims.label: OBS (published)
claims.transect_ref: T-SAB-OBS-833 Model B; applies as an upper-crustal SEDIMENTARY layer over any admissible crustal architecture
claims.layer: H1 SEDIMENTARY_MECHANICS — switchable independently of crust/mantle states
claims.kill_power: Strongest empirical maturity of the four displayed families.

claims.claim: Free-air gravity along the B–B′ dip transect swings 131 mGal: +94 mGal (Borneo hinterland) → −37 mGal (trough/fold belt) → +20 mGal (Dangerous Grounds)
claims.label: OBS (L0, grid-sampled at real coordinates)
claims.method: Sandwell & Smith V34.1 satellite free-air, 1 arc-min
claims.resolution_footprint: 1 arc-min (~2 km); onshore land-compilation values carry higher uncertainty
claims.uncertainty: stated indicative for the far-left (onshore) peak
claims.interpretation_firewall: Free-air response is also produced by bathymetry, sediment load and basement relief. Without Bouguer correction + forward model (water, sediments, upper/lower crust, mantle, Moho-depth & density sensitivity) this is COMPATIBILITY, not confirmation. The phrase 'independent check on the whole section' is withdrawn.

claims.claim: Seafloor expression on the youngest folds of the deepwater fold-thrust belt
claims.label: OBS
claims.method: bathymetric morphology at real coordinates (230–330 km chainage)
claims.interpretation_firewall: Demonstrates geologically YOUNG deformation. It does NOT by itself date present slip. 'Active now' requires modern seismicity, geodesy, growth strata reaching the seabed, or repeat bathymetry.

claims.claim: The NW Borneo Trough is a fossil subduction trench, choked by Dangerous Grounds continental crust in the Middle Miocene
claims.label: INT (recognized regional model; geometry, timing and Proto-SCS consumption continuity remain model-dependent)
claims.source: Hinz et al. 1989; Hazebroek & Tan 1993; Hutchison 2005; Morley 2024 — as cited on the page
claims.tag_rule: page must render 'is a fossil trench' as 'interpreted as a fossil trench (model)'

claims.claim: Present-day Sabah deformation includes both compression and extension: WNW–ESE shortening, active NE–SW thrusts, NW–SE strike-slip, normal faulting around the Crocker–Kinabalu uplift; SE Sabah shows deeper thrust-faulting seismicity
claims.label: OBS (seismicity/focal mechanisms) + INT (stress partitioning)
claims.method: focal mechanisms, hypocentres; GPS where published
claims.source: Tongkul 1994/1997 (as cited on observatory Sources); 2026 regional seismicity study (enterprise audit pass — attach DOI to page)
claims.kill_power: Requires a present-day kinematics panel on the observatory; inherited structure ≠ current slip mode.

claims.claim: Sarawak Cycles I–VIII are NOT formally calibrated against Sabah stages (IVA–IVE) or the Kinabalu SB4–SB8 sequence-boundary scheme
claims.label: OBS (of absence — internal project state)
claims.source: Kinabalu Basin project records (internal; biostrat/sequence-boundary assignments still unresolved)
claims.firewall: No cycle-to-SB crosswalk may be published from the Borneo page into Kinabalu usage until KL2 resolves it with the 80+ well databank. Confidence-bearing crosswalk is a KL2 deliverable, not a public-page assertion.

claims.claim: Airy isostatic root for 4,095 m relief = 22.9 km at the stated densities (reference crust 30 km); flexure and dynamic support omitted
claims.label: DER (valid only under declared flat-plate/air-load assumptions)
claims.method: analytical Airy calculation shown on page
claims.kill_power: NON-DECISIVE — end-member calculation; a flexed or dynamically supported crust does not have to reach it.

verdict_rules.R1: No model-family verdict may be rendered DECISIVE unless the killing claim has georeference_status containing a point or a declared footprint that overlaps the prediction, AND matching interface_definition.
verdict_rules.R2: Scores must be per-model. Dataset-wide status counts shown identically on every model card are a rendering defect, not evidence.
verdict_rules.R3: Potential-field fits are PERMITTED; only a second independent line (imaged body, dated material, diagnostic thermal anomaly) upgrades them to SUPPORTED.
verdict_rules.R4: Young morphology ≠ present activity. Model-dependent history statements carry INT tags.
verdict_rules.R5: Cross-domain transfer of numbers between transects is prohibited except through the analogue firewall in transects.json.
